questions.q: What is the correct order in a reflex arc?
options: receptor → motor neurone → relay neurone → sensory neurone → effector
receptor → sensory neurone → relay neurone → motor neurone → effector
effector → sensory neurone → relay neurone → motor neurone → receptor
receptor → relay neurone → sensory neurone → motor neurone → effector
questions.why: Impulses go from receptor via sensory, relay (in the CNS) and motor neurones to the effector.

questions.q: Which is an effect of adrenaline?
questions.why: Adrenaline increases breathing rate, heart rate and pupil diameter.

questions.q: Which gland is correctly paired with a hormone it secretes?
questions.why: Ovaries secrete oestrogen; testes – testosterone; adrenal glands – adrenaline; pancreas – insulin.

questions.model: A chemical substance, produced by a gland and carried by the blood, which alters the activity of one or more specific target organs.
points: alters the activity of specific target organs
